vep_command: vep -i variants.vcf -o <out> --offline --cache --dir_cache <cache> --cache_version 116 --species bos_taurus --assembly ARS-UCD2.0 --format vcf --buffer_size 5000 --fork 1 --fasta reference.fa --no_stats --quiet --force_overwrite [--tab|--vcf|--json]
fasta: the three sequences the records and the pruned cache's transcripts sit on (chromosome 25, MT and the unplaced scaffold NKLS02000103.1) at their full length from Bos_taurus.ARS-UCD2.0.dna.primary_assembly.25.fa, Bos_taurus.ARS-UCD2.0.dna.primary_assembly.MT.fa and Bos_taurus.ARS-UCD2.0.dna.nonchromosomal.fa of Ensembl release 116, every base outside the regions a run reads (each cached transcript's span with 5,000 bases of flank and each record with 2,000) masked to N; reference.fa.gz beside this file, compressed with bgzip, with reference.fa.gz.fai and reference.fa.gz.gzi for the compressed file and reference.fa.fai for its decompressed form; Ensembl VEP received the decompressed file as --fasta on every run
input: variants.vcf: 342 records on chromosome 25, the mitochondrion and one unplaced scaffold. 303 are the records tools/vep-seeded-variants writes for the three sequences from the converted cache (generator version 2, seed 1, --records wide, every reference allele read from the genome sequence), their IDs naming the category and an ordinal; twelve of them name their sequence by a synonym of the cache. 39 are known variants of the cache's own variation files on those sequences (dbSNP 150), single-base substitutions whose first allele is the genome's base, sampled with seed 1, their IDs the cache's identifiers, six of them multi-allelic

everything.vep_command: vep -i variants.vcf -o <out> --offline --cache --dir_cache <cache> --cache_version 116 --species bos_taurus --assembly ARS-UCD2.0 --format vcf --buffer_size 5000 --fork 1 --fasta reference.fa --no_stats --quiet --force_overwrite --everything [--tab|--vcf|--json]

hgvs-sift.vep_command: vep -i variants.vcf -o <out> --offline --cache --dir_cache <cache> --cache_version 116 --species bos_taurus --assembly ARS-UCD2.0 --format vcf --buffer_size 5000 --fork 1 --fasta reference.fa --no_stats --quiet --force_overwrite --hgvs --sift b [--tab|--vcf|--json]

generator: tools/vep-seeded-variants --cache <converted cache> --seed 1 --records wide --fasta <genome sequence> --sequence MT --sequence 25 --sequence NKLS02000103.1 for the seeded records, and 300 single-base substitutions sampled with seed 1 from the converted cache's variation files of the three sequences for the known ones; Ensembl VEP over the two inputs under the corpus flags; tools/vep-golden-corpus select --release 116 --assembly ARS-UCD2.0 --species bos_taurus --dataset wide=<reference>=<the seeded records> --dataset known=<reference>=<the known variants> --k 2 --seed 1 --max-span 1000000 --max-records 500 --cache <converted cache> --flank 5000 --focus-term <frameshift_variant, inframe_deletion, inframe_insertion, protein_altering_variant, start_lost, start_retained_variant, stop_lost, stop_retained_variant, stop_gained, missense_variant, synonymous_variant, incomplete_terminal_codon_variant> --focus-k 6 --include <every seeded record and 24 known variants> --covers species-cattle-ars-ucd2 --covers genetic-code-tables --fasta-name reference.fa.gz; scripts/golden/prune_json_cache.py --gzip --drop sorted_exons --drop protein_function_predictions --drop-except <the transcripts on which a record changes one residue, the rows SIFT scores> --perl-info <cache>/info.txt --cache-version 116 --variations <converted cache>/variations over the whole cache tools/vep-storable-to-json converts from the Ensembl VEP 116 ARS-UCD2.0 cache (protein features kept for the DOMAINS column of the everything set; the variation slices hold the known variants within one base of a record; the cache's regulatory data left out); scripts/fixtures/cut_plugin_regions.py --reference <genome sequence> --flank 5000 --record-flank 2000, the records read under the cache's names for their sequences; scripts/concordance/generate_reference_output.sh --corpus --no-stats for the manifest's run and each flag set; tools/vep-golden-corpus flag-set (everything, hgvs-sift) and classify (the manifest's run and both flag sets, --field HGVSc --field HGVSp --field HGVS_OFFSET for the everything set and --field HGVSc --field HGVSp --field SIFT --field HGVS_OFFSET for the hgvs-sift set); the HGVSc and HGVS_OFFSET entries of the insertion and the deletion within 1,000 bases of the scaffold's first base carry the class hgvs_shift_sequence_edge_window, which tools/vep-formats-compare --masks hgvs_shift_sequence_edge_window --json-cache <the corpus cache> --reference-fasta <the corpus reference> reads from the reference and the cache on both flag sets

pruned_cache.variation_slices: the known variants within one base of a record under variations/<chr>/all_vars.gz with its .csi, as the Ensembl VEP cache lays them out: 116 on chromosome 25 and 19 on MT; the scaffold, which has none there, carries the empty indexed file
